newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai flies wrong flag for German president.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai flies wrong flag for German president.

text.p: Shanghai airport put out the wrong national flag to greet visiting German president Roman Herzog last week, but a quick-sighted consular official spotted the mistake in time, a Shanghai newspaper said on Friday.
The Shanghai Traffic Safety newspaper said the flag was put up "due to negligence by the relevant departments" and belonged to an unnamed African country.

A policeman raced across town to get a German flag from the German consulate and by the time the president arrived for the November 21 visit, the correct flag was flying from the flagpole, the paper said.
